title: Old Fashioned Korean Pinto Bean Tang
description: A charred, crunchy, nostalgic Korean dish featuring pinto beans, shio-cure, and kosher-friendly ingredients, served as a tang.
instructions: Drain and rinse the soaked pinto beans, then transfer them to a large pot with enough water to cover the beans.
Bring the water to a boil, then reduce the heat to a simmer and cook the beans until they are tender.
In a small bowl, mix together the shio cure, kosher salt, and brown sugar.
Add the shio cure mixture to the cooked pinto beans and stir to combine.
Heat the sesame oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat, then add the minced garlic and grated ginger and cook until fragrant.
Add the cooked pinto beans to the skillet and stir to combine with the garlic and ginger.
Use a spoon to char and crunch the pinto bean mixture, stirring frequently.
Transfer the pinto bean tang to a serving bowl and garnish with chopped scallions and crushed black pepper.
Serve the Old Fashioned Korean Pinto Bean Tang hot, garnished with additional scallions if desired.
